fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: No Īmān without accepting the judgment of the Prophet ﷺ
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that Allah swears by Himself: no one believes until he makes the Messenger ﷺ judge in disputes and submits completely.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Muḥākamah is not only the language of courts. It is the heart’s devotion to Allah’s revelation and to the judgment of His Messenger ﷺ.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:65.
